commitments.text: NCL must construct and maintain a buffer zone to serve as public open space to the north and west of the proposed plant (the 'applicable land'), consisting of a natural area landscaped with trees and berms. NCL must register a covenant under section 219 of the Land Title Act against the title to the applicable lands or implement an alternative mechanism, either of which must be satisfactory to the District of Taylor, which provides that the applicable lands will continue to be used and maintained as a buffer zone. If an alternative mechanism is implemented, NCL must comply with any direction of the District of Taylor with respect to the means of ensuring that the applicable lands continue to be used and maintained as a buffer zone.
